name: NIGHT TRAIN
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless night train: passing landscapes, stations, passengers with stories
description: NIGHT TRAIN turns the FM-1 into a window on an endless night journey. The train runs a seeded route between stations: forest, coast, city lights, snowfields, mountains, villages, lakes, moors, with tunnels, bridges, signal stops and rain. Each stretch has its own key and sound; the wheels' clack is the beat and follows the train's speed. At stations it slows, chimes, and passengers get on and off: a conductor, a night nurse, a cellist, an old man who won't say where he is going, an art student and a cat, with stories that go on from night to night. It plays itself and remembers the journey.
credits: Engine: AMB-1 by Charles Vestal. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
